- id: R1
  status: doing
  title: "REST Blog API (stdlib, single file)"
  quote: "Build a REST Blog API in Python using only the standard library (http.server + sqlite3). CRUD for posts, X-API-Key auth, JSON bodies, localhost:8080, single file blog_api.py."
  steps:
    - {do: "Spec written and lint passes", check: "cmd: PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/blog-api/spec.yaml --formal"}
    - {do: "User approves the spec (request-approval, approve)", ok: false}

  next: "write spec, lint, package, ask the user to approve"

cat > forgemyspec-bundle/blog-api/spec.yaml <<'EOF'
version: "0.1"
title: "REST Blog API"
objective: "A single-file Python REST API (blog_api.py) using only http.server and sqlite3, offering CRUD for blog posts with JSON bodies and X-API-Key authentication, served on localhost:8080."
execution_mode: critical
context:
  system: "Empty Python repository; target is one file blog_api.py at the repository root, Python 3 standard library only."
  assumptions:
    - "A post has id (integer, assigned by the server), title (non-empty string), body (non-empty string), created_at and updated_at (UTC ISO-8601 strings)."
    - "Routes: POST /posts, GET /posts, GET /posts/{id}, PUT /posts/{id} (full replace), DELETE /posts/{id}."
    - "The valid API key comes from the environment variable BLOG_API_KEY; the server refuses to start when it is unset or empty."
    - "The SQLite file path comes from BLOG_DB_PATH, default blog.db; tests use a temporary file."
    - "Binding is 127.0.0.1 port 8080 by default; tests may start the server on another port through the factory function."
    - "No pagination, no users, no comments, no tags."
constraints:
  - "Only the Python standard library; no third-party packages."
  - "Everything lives in the single file blog_api.py."
  - "The server binds to 127.0.0.1, never to 0.0.0.0."
  - "SQL uses parameterized queries only, never string formatting of user input."
  - "No HTTPS, no CORS, no pagination, no user accounts."
success_criteria:
  - "All five post routes behave as specified, with JSON request and response bodies."
  - "Every request without a correct X-API-Key is answered 401 and changes nothing."
  - "Boundary tests pass against a real server on a temporary database."
hypotheses:
  - {id: h1, description: "POST /posts with a valid JSON body creates a post and answers 201 with the stored post including its id.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h2, description: "GET /posts lists all posts and GET /posts/{id} returns one post, answering 404 for an unknown id.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h3, description: "PUT /posts/{id} replaces title and body of an existing post and DELETE /posts/{id} removes it, both answering 404 for an unknown id.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h4, description: "Any request without a valid X-API-Key header is rejected with 401 and no data is read or changed.", confidence: 0.9}
  - {id: h5, description: "Invalid input (malformed JSON, non-object body, missing or empty title/body, non-string fields) is rejected with 400 and a JSON error.", confidence: 0.85}
  - {id: h6, description: "The server binds to localhost port 8080 by default and persists posts in SQLite.", confidence: 0.85}
required_evidence:
  - "Output of the unittest run showing every boundary test passing."
  - "Output of the gate command ending in RESULT: PASS."
actions:
  - {id: a1, description: "Implement blog_api.py with the routes, auth check, validation and SQLite storage.", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
  - {id: a2, description: "Write boundary tests that start the server on a free port with a temp database and call it with urllib.", type: implement, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
  - {id: a3, description: "Run the unittest suite and the gate.", type: validate, requires_confirmation: false, supports: [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]}
decision_rules:
  - "If a behavior is not covered by an obligation, stop and ask for a spec amendment."
  - "If the gate fails, fix the code, never the tests."
metadata:
  source_prompt: "Build a REST Blog API in Python using only the standard library (http.server + sqlite3). CRUD for posts, X-API-Key auth, JSON bodies, localhost:8080, single file blog_api.py."
  generator: claude-code-session
  scope_contract:
    must_include:
      - "CRUD for posts"
      - "X-API-Key auth"
      - "JSON bodies"
      - "localhost:8080"
      - "single file blog_api.py"
      - "standard library only"
formal:
  module: BlogApi
  obligations:
    - id: create_post
      kind: boundary
      statement: "POST /posts with valid JSON title and body answers 201 and returns the post with id; GET /posts/{id} then returns it."
      hypotheses: [h1]
      must_include: ["CRUD for posts"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_create_then_get"
    - id: read_posts
      kind: boundary
      statement: "GET /posts lists all posts; GET /posts/{id} of an unknown id answers 404."
      hypotheses: [h2]
      must_include: ["CRUD for posts"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_list_and_unknown_id_404"
    - id: update_delete_post
      kind: boundary
      statement: "PUT replaces title and body; DELETE removes the post; both answer 404 for an unknown id and a deleted post is then 404."
      hypotheses: [h3]
      must_include: ["CRUD for posts"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_update_and_delete"
    - id: api_key_required
      kind: boundary
      statement: "A request with a missing or wrong X-API-Key answers 401 on every route and leaves the database unchanged."
      hypotheses: [h4]
      must_include: ["X-API-Key auth"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_auth_required_and_no_side_effects"
    - id: json_validation
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Malformed JSON, non-object bodies, missing, empty or non-string title/body answer 400 with a JSON error body; all responses carry Content-Type application/json."
      hypotheses: [h5]
      must_include: ["JSON bodies"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_invalid_bodies_400"
    - id: bind_localhost_8080
      kind: boundary
      statement: "The default host is 127.0.0.1 and the default port is 8080; startup fails when BLOG_API_KEY is unset."
      hypotheses: [h6]
      must_include: ["localhost:8080"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_defaults_and_requires_key"
    - id: persistence_sqlite
      kind: boundary
      statement: "Posts survive a server restart on the same SQLite file."
      hypotheses: [h6]
      must_include: ["single file blog_api.py"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_persists_across_restart"
    - id: stdlib_only
      kind: boundary
      statement: "blog_api.py imports only standard library modules (checked via sys.stdlib_module_names)."
      hypotheses: [h6]
      must_include: ["standard library only"]
      test: "test_blog_api.BlogApiTests.test_imports_stdlib_only"
scope:
  paths: ["blog_api.py", "tests/**"]
  tests: tests
  pythonpath: ["."]
EOF
export PYTHONPATH=.forgemyspec/harness
python3 -m forgemyspec lint forgemyspec-bundle/blog-api/spec.yaml --formal && python3 -m forgemyspec package forgemyspec-bundle/blog-api/spec.yaml

| Obligation | Checks |
|---|---|
| `create_post` | `POST /posts` returns 201 with the post and its id, and `GET /posts/{id}` then returns it. |
| `read_posts` | `GET /posts` lists the posts, and an unknown id returns 404. |
| `update_delete_post` | `PUT` replaces title and body, `DELETE` removes the post, and an unknown id returns 404. |
| `api_key_required` | A missing or wrong `X-API-Key` returns 401 on every route and changes nothing. |
| `json_validation` | Malformed JSON, a non-object body, or a missing, empty or non-string title or body returns 400. All responses are JSON. |
| `bind_localhost_8080` | The default bind is 127.0.0.1:8080, and the server won't start without `BLOG_API_KEY`. |
| `persistence_sqlite` | Posts survive a restart on the same SQLite file. |
| `stdlib_only` | `blog_api.py` imports only standard library modules. |

**Assumptions I made, since you didn't specify them:**
- A post has `id`, `title`, `body`, `created_at` and `updated_at`.
- The routes are `/posts` and `/posts/{id}`, and `PUT` replaces the whole post.
- The API key comes from the `BLOG_API_KEY` environment variable.
- The database path comes from `BLOG_DB_PATH` and defaults to `blog.db`.
- There is no pagination, CORS, HTTPS or user accounts.
